prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: transparent raster vehicle selector asset for a friendly carpool website, matching polished realistic automobile catalog cutouts.
Primary request: Create a humorous Chinese “宝马车” pun: it is literally one handsome chestnut horse pulling a small passenger carriage. This is a real horse-and-carriage, never a BMW automobile.
Subject: ONE compact but anatomically believable chestnut horse with a proud, slightly jaunty upright head and dark mane, wearing sensible dark leather harness. The horse stands naturally, attached by two visible shafts and coherent harness traces to a small FOUR-WHEEL open passenger carriage behind it. Passenger carriage has a dark navy painted body, warm dark wood trim, a modest comfortable empty passenger bench, small brass details and clearly readable spoke wheels. No people.
Style/medium: refined realistic 3D product render with tactile materials and believable proportions, a little charming and playful, not a flat drawing. Crisp silhouette readable as a small website thumbnail.
Composition/framing: one isolated complete horse and carriage assembly in a landscape composition. Front-left three-quarter view, slightly elevated camera looking down gently, horse faces and travels toward the lower left, carriage extends toward the upper right. Compact composition but structurally plausible shaft length. Entire horse, ears, hooves, tail, harness, carriage and all wheel extents fit in frame with a clear transparent margin. Do not crop. Distinguish the horse's four legs naturally.
Lighting: soft studio lighting, subtle specular highlights, soft short contact shadow immediately underneath hooves and wheels.
Scene/backdrop: genuinely transparent alpha background, no scenery, no road, no parking lines, no pedestal, no white rectangle, no checkerboard baked into image.
Avoid: automobiles or horse/car hybrids, BMW badge or any logo, letters, numbers, captions, watermark, driver, passengers, extra animals, repeated legs, floating/disconnected harness, steep isometric view, heavy cartoon outline.
Output: one clean transparent PNG asset.
referenceUsage: Visually inspected for product-render style and front-left orientation; new image generated from text.

edits.prompt:
Use case: background-extraction
Edit the attached horse-and-carriage PNG only to clean its transparency. Preserve the entire horse and carriage EXACTLY: same anatomy, pose, harness and shaft connections, number and position of wheels, upholstery, colors, textures, fine detail, lighting on the objects, relative proportions, camera angle and composition.
The original image has a broad brown-gray fog halo around the horse and carriage. Remove ALL of that fog, color mist, background tint, glow and outer glow. Every pixel outside the actual solid-object silhouette must be clean fully transparent alpha zero, including the open spaces between spokes, under the chassis, between the legs and around ears and mane. Use clean natural antialiased edges with no colored fringe. Allow only a very faint tiny neutral contact shadow directly beneath hooves and wheel contact points; no aura or floor shadow across empty space. Add approximately 5 percent clean transparent margin around the entire assembly if necessary, without cropping.
Do not repaint, redesign or move any part. Do not add a background, checkerboard, text, logo, watermark, scenery, floor or frame. Output a clean transparent PNG cutout for use over a pale green webpage.
edits.visualReview: Inspected an auxiliary pale-green composited QA image: silhouette and wheel-spoke openings are clean, no broad brown-gray halo. Horse and carriage composition retained; full ears, hooves and wheels in frame.
